subject: Request: SOC 2 / SIG evidence + incident response timeline for logging discrepancy
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@finsecure.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request + incident timeline

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As part of our vendor due diligence we need a small package of artifacts related to your SOC 2 controls and, specifically, any evidence tied to the recent logging discrepancy we saw on 2027-03-30. Our security team needs enough detail to close our assessment and to map controls for SOC 2 / SIG.

What we need (at a minimum):
- A copy of your latest IR plan (redacted as necessary) and the person(s) responsible for escalation
- A timeline of the 2027-03-30 logging discrepancy (detected, investigation start, mitigation, resolution)
- Export of access logs and any supporting telemetry for 2027-03-30 (or a slice relevant to the incident)
- Confirmation of whether any user PII was involved and what sanitization you will perform for evidence transfer
- SIG / CAIQ pointers to where controls map to your evidence (if you have a crosswalk)

We prefer secure transfer (SFTP or shared Drive link with restricted access). Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Samir (cc) is procurement — he may ask about any contractual notes.

Appreciate a response by EOD tomorrow if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Security, FinSecure

Attachments: None referenced
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@finsecure.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request + incident timeline

Elena — thanks for the note and for the clear list. I'm looping in Karthik (security) and Evelyn (Trust) to own the artifact delivery.

Short answer: we can provide a redacted IR plan, a time-ordered incident timeline, and a sanitized slice of logs. We will not share raw PII; we will redact/sanitize logs and provide attestations where needed.

Proposed plan and rough ETA:
- Today/Tomorrow: confirm scope and transfer method (SFTP or restricted Drive link) + sign any needed NDA/transfer form
- 2027-04-05: deliver redacted IR plan + timeline draft + initial log slice (redacted)
- 2027-04-06: deliver final sanitized logs and brief postmortem PDF

Karthik — can you confirm the log formats we'll drop and whether the access-logs CSV will cover the slice Elena asked for?

Elena / Samir — if there's a preferred transfer method or a contact for your secure intake system, please advise and we'll follow that.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <security@finsecure.com>, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request + incident timeline

Hi all,

Thanks for the ping. Quick technical answers and deliverables we can commit to:

Deliverables (planned):
1) IR_Plan_Redacted_v1.pdf — redacted incident contact information removed, control references preserved (will include a page that maps IR plan sections to SIG control IDs)
2) incident-timeline-20270330.txt — time-ordered entries (detected, triage, remediation actions, verification)
3) access-logs-20270330.csv.gz — gzipped CSV with columns [timestamp, instance_id, actor_id (hashed), action, source_ip (CIDR-redacted)]
4) postmortem-brief-20270406.pdf — one-page summary for procurement/security with impact and mitigation steps

Notes on PII and sanitization:
- We will hash or tokenise actor identifiers and redact any email addresses or full UUIDs.
- IPs will be anonymized to /24 where necessary per our data-handling policy.
- We will include a short attestation statement about the sanitization steps performed.

Transfer method: we can upload to a restricted Drive folder and share access to the exact accounts you provide, or set up a one-time SFTP drop. For high-sensitivity evidence we prefer SFTP.

Proposed timeline (confirmed):
- 2027-04-05 18:00 UTC: initial package (IR plan + timeline + sample log slice) via Drive link
- 2027-04-06 23:59 UTC: full sanitized log archive + postmortem brief + attestation

Request: please confirm a primary contact for the Drive/SFTP access and whether you need a signed evidence transfer form. Also — would a 30-minute review call on 2027-04-06 14:00 PT work for your team?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: planned list above (will be delivered in Drive/SFTP)
From: Elena Morales <security@finsecure.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Gupta <procurement@finsecure.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG evidence request + incident timeline

Thanks — that timeline looks good and SFTP is fine for the full logs. Confirming:
- Primary intake contact: elena.m@finsecure.com (we'll grant access once you send the drop credentials)
- We do not require an additional NDA for this transfer (procurement flagged that in the thread)
- 30-minute review call 2027-04-06 14:00 PT: Samir and I can make that if you can send a calendar invite; otherwise we'll take the package and review asynchronously

One procurement note from Samir (cc): if this incident maps to any contractual SLA credits, let us know. Otherwise we'll proceed with the due diligence review and close our outstanding items.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. I look forward to the Drive link / SFTP credentials and the initial package.

Best,
Elena
